description: Header file defining the Windows-specific implementation of DHCP PAC file fetching, including class declarations, methods, and internal state management for DHCP-based PAC URL retrieval.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileFetcherWin
classes.description: Windows-specific DHCP PAC file fetcher implementing the DhcpPacFileFetcher interface, managing DHCP adapter queries and PAC URL retrieval.

classes.name: AdapterQuery
classes.description: Inner class handling adapter name queries on a worker thread, with methods to perform DHCP adapter enumeration and logging.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Initiates fetching of the PAC file, providing callback, logging, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: GetFetcherName
methods.description: Returns the name of the fetcher.

methods.name: GetCandidateAdapterNames
methods.description: Static method to retrieve DHCP-enabled adapter names, optionally logging info.

methods.name: num_pending_fetchers
methods.description: Returns the number of pending fetchers.

methods.name: GetTaskRunner
methods.description: Returns the task runner used for DHCP lookup tasks.

methods.name: AdapterQuery::GetCandidateAdapterNames
methods.description: Performs DHCP adapter enumeration on a worker thread.

methods.name: ImplCreateAdapterFetcher
methods.description: Creates a DHCP PAC file adapter fetcher instance.

methods.name: ImplGetMaxWait
methods.description: Returns maximum wait time for DHCP queries.

methods.name: ImplOnGetCandidateAdapterNamesDone
methods.description: Hook for post-processing after adapter name retrieval.
